coverage: Legacy theme without settings.schema.json and field default merging; explicit empty string, false, and media null stay distinct from omitted overrides.
Inactive theme settings; theme switching and fallback use independent saved configurations; actual Default template output.
Schema/default/constraint rejection, unknown fields, release/schema/edit version conflict, same-version no-op saves, restart persistence and compatible reconciliation.
Same-slug same-release uninstall/reinstall changes UUID; old pages cannot save or uninstall the new record.
Media attachment/replacement/removal, private usage disclosure, reference audit rollback, and purge protection even if bookkeeping is missing.
Install audit failure and deferred uninstall commit failure compensate the directory and registry without losing saved configuration or references.

Actual child process exit 86 at install.prepared, install.published, install.committed, uninstall.prepared, uninstall.quarantined and uninstall.committed; normal startup resolves journals and orphan staging directories.
A still-pending original uninstall transaction is fenced by the PostgreSQL THEMES lock before filesystem compensation.
Request cancellation retains the package mutation guard; recovery mode does not initialize records or mutate theme files.
First installation remains empty through theme preflight; post-bootstrap theme initialization failure resumes without duplicate accounts.
Forward migration 0006 to 0007 preserves theme selection and plugin settings; generated schema, runtime/maintenance grants and API contract checked.
Real backup/restore retains theme overrides and media refs; unfinished package journal refuses backup, missing theme ref refuses release, isolated serve does not initialize missing theme records.
limitations: Flat scalar fields only: text, textarea, integer, boolean, select, color and media; no nested/list configuration or arbitrary upgrade scripts.
One normal serve process per theme root. Filesystem lease prevents stale registries across processes; no multi-instance theme propagation.
Incompatible saved data is preserved. Default incompatibility blocks startup; another incompatible theme becomes unavailable until a compatible package or explicit data repair is supplied.
Process exits and pending database decisions were tested; physical power loss and an actual network proxy dropping a commit acknowledgement were not injected.
